title:
Comment of Connie Fredenberg in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/11/2026

documents.name: 151512.txt
documents.text:
Connie Fredenberg, Palmer, AK.
The DeepGreen Cook Inlet SPV LLC application for a Data Center to be built underwater in Cook Inlet is a bad idea and should never be approved.  

That area is critical habitat for endangered Beluga Whales and fish we need for food.  

In addition to the noise and heat it will produce, Cook Inlet is in an earthquake zone.  A powerful earthquake could happen any time and will cause PFAS and other contaminants to pollute Cook Inlet. 

There is no upside to this proposal. Drop it.
